simple.meaning: עֵדָה (ʻêdâh) appears 149 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Exodus 12:3. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, land, wilderness, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֵדָה (H5712) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֵדָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse , or generally, a family or crowd )
definitions.usage: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare 5713 .
definitions.full: H5712. edah עֵדָה 140 noun feminine congregation (properly company assembled together by appointment , or acting concertedly ) — ׳ע Num 16:2 85t.; construct עֲדַת Exod 12:3 52t.; suffix עֲדָתִי Job 16:7 9 t. suffixes; — 1 עֲדַתאֵֿל Psa 82:1 congregation of El , of company of angels ׅ || אלהים (בקרב ; ׳ע לְאֻמִּים 7:8 congregation of peoples ; ׳ע צַדִּיקִים 1:5 congregation of the righteous ; || יְשָׁרִים סוֺד 111:1 ; || קהל Prov 5:14 ; כָּלעֲֿדָתִי Job 16:7 (of Job's circle of dependents); in a bad sense, ׳ע מְרֵעִים company of evil doers Psa 22:17 ; ׳ע עריצים 86:14 ; ׳ע חנף Job 15:34 ; ׳ע קֹרַח company of Korah Num 26:9 ; 27:3 (P), so עֲדָֽתְךָ עֲדָתוֺ, 16:5-6 , 11 , 16 ; 17:5 (P), and הָעֵדָה 26:10 ; 27:3 (P); ׳ע אֲבִירָם Psa 106:17 , compare 106:18 . 2 of animals אַבִּירִים ׳ע Psa 68:31 (figurative of nobles); ׳ע דְּבֹרִים Judg 14:8 a swarm of bees. 3 elsewhere of Israel Hosea 7:12 עֲדָתָם i.e. the whole assemblage of them; 1Kin 8:5 (= 2Chr 5:6 ) ישׂ עדת ׳כל of those gathered to Solomon; 2 Chron 12:20 העדה of assembly at Shechem; Jer 6:18 (text very dubious); עֲדָתוֺ 30:20 of restored people; עֲדָֽתְךָ Psa 74:2 (|| נחלתך שׁבט ); elsewhere in P, except possibly Num 20:11 (R), in technical sense, of the company of Israel of the Exodus, the congregation (115 t.), especially in the phrases ׳ע יהוה 27:17 ; 31:16 ; Josh 22:16-17 , ׳ע ישׂראל Exod 12:3 , 6 , 19 , 47 ; Lev 4:13 ; Num 16:9 ; 32:4 ; Josh 22:18 , 20 ; ׳ע ישׂראל בני Exod 16:1-2 , 9 , 10 ; 17:1 ; 35:1 , 4 , 20 ; Lev 16:5 ; 19:2 (H), Num 1:2 , 53 ; 8:9 , 20 ; 13:26 ; 14:5 , 7 ; 15:25-26 , 17:6 ; 19:9 ; 25:6 ; 27:20 ; 31:12 ; Josh 18:1 ; 22:12 ; הָעֵדָה Lev 8:4 29 t. (compare Judg 20:1 ; 21:10 ); ׳כלהֿע Lev 8:3 33 t.
